strategy.summary: Reproduce the silent wrong-value bug in cvxpy quad_form_canon for an indefinite P under assume_PSD=True. The buggy revision solves without error and returns OPTIMAL with the wrong value, so the regression test's pytest.raises(ValueError) fails. The fixed revision raises ValueError with 'indefinite' and 'PSD' in the message, so the test passes. Build from source at the buggy commit, install SCS in the 3.2.4.post1 or later range, and run only the new test.
